saints.name: St. Dunstan
saints.title: Bishop
saints.shortBlurb: The Abbot of Glastonbury and Archbishop of Canterbury who revived English monastic life in the tenth century…
biography: Dunstan was born near Glastonbury and rose to be its abbot, where he restored monastic discipline according to the Rule of St. Benedict. A statesman as well as a monk, he served several kings of the English and was made Archbishop of Canterbury about 960.

With the bishops Ethelwold and Oswald he led a great reform of the English Church, founding and renewing monasteries throughout the land. Skilled as a metalworker, scribe, and musician, he is remembered as patron of goldsmiths; he died at Canterbury in 988.
saints.knownFor: The revival of English monastic life as Archbishop of Canterbury.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 19 May
